The '''tals''' were a non-[[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species kept as pets by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] residents of the industrial world [[Yalln]]. One resident of Yalln, [[Clenna]], spent much of his youth exploring the extensive wilderness outside the industrial complexes with his trusty tal.
